summary: CKGSB's global marketing team is in a critical push to launch the Intelligent China webpage this week while advancing the China Going-Global report and Asia Start as top priorities, with urgent follow-ups on Tech in Asia Conference engagement and website redesign feedback.
summaryDetail: The most urgent item is the launch of the Intelligent China webpage this week, which requires Joseph to create three tabs with separate URLs and prioritize Module 1 for marketing and sales material. In parallel, the team is focused on the China Going-Global report and Asia Start as the top two marketing priorities, with Joseph drafting an audit plan for target areas and the team analyzing participant profiles and CRM leads to support SEO and conversion tracking. This week also demands immediate attention to Tech in Asia Conference follow-ups: Alan Chen must add upcoming program lists to the thank-you email, Ben and Jay need to create touch points and craft the email with Marcom support, and Ira must review and send the email to GP. Additionally, the knowledge website redesign requires Joseph to share his HTML design and hold a 30-minute feedback session with Julie to finalize improvements like menu categorization and card-based design. Looking ahead, Joseph must provide October priorities for website, SEM/SEO, GEO, and content by September 25, and the team should continue resolving Outlook account lock issues across all devices.
